_about: Skill ladders written for BodySync (original wording, common coaching practice). Targets follow the widely used guidance of roughly 10-12 clean reps (or 20-30 second holds) before moving up. Not medical advice.

ladders.title: Push-up
ladders.blurb: From a plank to full push-ups, one manageable step at a time.

warmup.name: Arm circles
warmup.how: 30 seconds forward, 30 seconds back. Start small and get bigger.

warmup.name: Arm swings
warmup.how: Swing both arms wide open, then hug yourself. 20 reps. Loosens the chest and shoulders.

steps.name: Plank hold
steps.how: Hands or forearms under your shoulders, body in one straight line, squeeze your glutes and stomach. Stop the set if your hips sag.

steps.name: Wall push-up
steps.how: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands at shoulder height. Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then press back. Keep your body straight.

options.name: Slow-lowering wall push-up
options.how: Lower your chest to the wall over 3 seconds, then push back.

steps.name: Incline push-up
steps.how: Hands on a sturdy table, counter or sofa. Lower your chest to the edge and press up. A lower surface is harder, so move down over time.

steps.name: Knee push-up
steps.how: Knees on the floor, straight line from knees to head. Lower your chest to just above the floor, then press up.

options.name: Slow-lowering knee push-up
options.how: On your knees, lower over 3 seconds; it's fine to push back up from the floor.

options.name: Low incline push-up
options.how: Hands on a low step or bench, body in one straight line.

steps.name: Slow-lowering push-up
steps.how: Start at the top of a full push-up. Lower for 3 to 5 seconds all the way down, drop to your knees, reset. This builds the strength to press back up.

options.name: Long plank hold
options.how: Straight-arm or forearm plank, body in one line, squeeze your glutes.

steps.name: Full push-up
steps.how: Hands just wider than your shoulders, body straight from head to heels. Lower until your chest is near the floor, then press up.

ladders.title: Harder push-ups
ladders.blurb: Once full push-ups feel solid: new hand positions and angles.

warmup.name: Arm swings
warmup.how: Swing both arms wide open, then hug yourself. 20 reps.

steps.name: Full push-up
steps.how: Clean, controlled reps with your body in one line. Build to 12 before changing the shape.

steps.name: Wide push-up
steps.how: Hands wider than your shoulders. Works the chest more. Keep your elbows pointing back and out at about 45 degrees.

steps.name: Narrow push-up
steps.how: Hands under your chest, close together. Elbows brush your sides as you lower.

steps.name: Triceps push-up
steps.library: Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell
steps.how: Hands under your shoulders, elbows tucked tight against your ribs. Go slowly. This one targets the back of the arms.

steps.name: Decline push-up
steps.how: Feet on a low step or sofa, hands on the floor. Keep your hips level with your shoulders.

ladders.title: Pull-up
ladders.blurb: Build the hang, the shoulders and the pull, then put it together.

warmup.name: Shoulder shrugs
warmup.how: 10 slow shrugs, lifting and lowering your shoulders.

steps.name: Dead hang
steps.how: Hang from a bar with straight arms and your shoulders slightly pulled down. Use a step to get up and down, and come down before your grip gives out.

steps.name: Scapular pull-up
steps.how: Hang with straight arms, then pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises a little. Do not bend your elbows.

steps.name: Inverted row
steps.how: Lie under a sturdy bar or table edge, grip it, and pull your chest up to it with a straight body. Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

steps.name: Slow-lowering pull-up
steps.how: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar. Lower yourself for 4 to 5 seconds until your arms are straight.

options.name: Flexed-arm hang
options.how: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar, then hold it there.

steps.name: Band-assisted pull-up
steps.how: Loop a resistance band over the bar and under your knee or foot. Pull your chin over the bar. Use a thinner band over time.

options.name: Slow-lowering pull-up, 5 reps
options.how: Start with your chin over the bar and lower over 3 to 5 seconds.

steps.name: Pull-up
steps.how: Hands just wider than your shoulders, pull until your chin clears the bar, lower with control.

ladders.title: Pistol squat
ladders.blurb: Single-leg squat strength, balance and depth.
ladders.final: Pistol squats, 3 sets of 3 per side

warmup.name: Leg swings
warmup.how: 10 forward and back swings per leg, holding a wall for balance.

warmup.name: Hip circles
warmup.how: 10 slow circles each way per leg.

steps.name: Bodyweight squat
steps.how: Feet shoulder-width apart, sit back and down with your heels flat, then stand.

steps.name: Deep squat hold
steps.how: Sit at the bottom of a squat with your heels down. Hold a door frame or post for balance if you need to.

steps.name: Split squat
steps.how: One foot forward, one back. Lower your back knee toward the floor and stand. Switch sides.

steps.name: Bench pistol (sit to stand)
steps.how: Sit on a bench with one leg held out in front. Stand up on the other leg, then sit back down slowly.

steps.name: Assisted pistol squat
steps.how: Hold a post or door frame lightly. Squat down on one leg with the other held out, then stand. Use less hand help over time.

steps.name: Pistol squat
steps.how: Squat down on one leg with the other held out in front, then stand back up with no help.

ladders.title: Handstand
ladders.blurb: Strong shoulders and wrists first, then the wall, then balance.
ladders.safety: Practise on a mat or carpet with clear space, and come down the way you went up. Skip any step that hurts your wrists or neck.

warmup.name: Wrist circles and rocks
warmup.how: 10 circles each way, then gently rock forward and back over your hands.

steps.name: Plank hold
steps.how: Hands under shoulders, body in one line. This is the shape you will hold upside down.

steps.name: Pike hold
steps.how: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high like an upside-down V, head between your arms. Push the floor away.

steps.name: Chest-to-wall hold
steps.how: Facing the wall, walk your feet up it until your chest is close to the wall. Hold, then walk back down.

steps.name: Back-to-wall kick-up hold
steps.how: Facing away from the wall, place your hands a short distance from it and kick up gently until your heels touch. Squeeze your body tight and hold.

steps.name: Freestanding handstand
steps.how: Kick up near a wall, then try to balance with your heels off it. Spread your fingers and make tiny corrections with your hands.

ladders.title: Touch your toes
ladders.blurb: Gentle, steady flexibility work for your hamstrings and back.
ladders.final: Palms flat on the floor in a forward fold
ladders.safety: Never bounce. Ease off if you feel sharp pain or tingling. A gentle stretch is the goal.

warmup.name: Cat-cow
warmup.how: 10 slow rounds on your hands and knees, arching and rounding your back.

warmup.name: Hamstring wake-up
warmup.how: Standing, one heel forward with toes up. Hinge slightly from the hips for 20 seconds each leg.

steps.name: Bent-knee forward fold
steps.how: Feet hip-width apart, soften your knees and fold from the hips. Let your arms and head hang heavy.

steps.name: Forward fold, hands on shins
steps.how: Straighten your legs as far as is comfortable and rest your hands on your shins.

steps.name: Forward fold, hands to ankles
steps.how: Walk your hands down to your ankles or toes with a long spine, folding from the hips.

steps.name: Forward fold, palms to the floor
steps.how: Bring your palms toward the floor, keeping your legs as straight as you can.

ladders.title: Front splits
ladders.blurb: Hip flexor and hamstring work, then a little closer to the floor each week.
ladders.final: A full front split, held 30 seconds per side
ladders.safety: Ease into mild tension, never sharp pain. Go slowly, breathe, and warm up first. Not medical advice.

warmup.name: Leg swings
warmup.how: Hold a wall. 10 swings forward and back, each leg.

warmup.name: Walking lunges
warmup.how: 10 slow steps, sinking gently into each one.

warmup.name: Hip circles
warmup.how: Hands on hips, 10 slow circles each way.

drills.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
drills.how: Kneel on one knee, other foot in front. Tuck your hips under and shift forward until you feel the front of the back hip.

drills.name: Seated hamstring stretch
drills.how: Sit tall with legs straight. Hinge forward from the hips with a long back, not a rounded one.

drills.name: Hip flexor and quad stretch
drills.library: Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch
drills.how: From a low lunge, reach back for your back foot and draw it gently toward you.

steps.name: Low lunge
steps.how: Back knee down, front knee over the ankle, hips square. Sink forward gently.

steps.name: Half split
steps.how: From a low lunge, sit back onto the back heel and straighten the front leg. Fold forward with a long back.

steps.name: Split on blocks
steps.how: Slide the front heel forward with hands on two blocks or stacked books. Stop where you can still breathe easily.

steps.name: Split, hands down
steps.how: Lower until your hands rest on the floor. Keep the back knee pointing down, not out.

steps.name: Full front split
steps.how: Both legs straight, hips square, sitting all the way down. Use a cushion under the hip until you get there.
